data.long_meaning: Anikait is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ani' meaning 'one' and 'kait' meaning 'different'. This name signifies being unique and individual in one's identity. Parents who choose Anikait usually hope their child will grow to embody different, unique and live with faith, good character and purpose.
